# Real radiotherapy contour names, for the organ-key reachability test (defect #22).
#
# NAMES ONLY. No patient identifier, no date, no dose and no outcome appears in this file, and
# nothing here can be traced to a person. It exists so that
# _validate_default_organ_keys_reachable() can be checked against names a treatment planning
# system actually exports, instead of against canon_target(key) == key, which is a tautology:
# the old check compared the alias table with itself and passed however badly the table drifted.
#
# Sources (all read-only; harvested from run provenance already recorded in
# project_rbGyanx/rbGyanX_Manuscript_Workspace/02_Run_Outputs):
#   TCIA2 head-and-neck (AIRTP contour names), v1.3.0 STRUCTURE_CENSUS -> 53 names
#   v1.3.0 reachability census (all cohorts) -> 432 names
#   21 structure_mapping.csv files (PAROTID / SPARK / validation runs) -> 6 names
#
# STILL TO ADD, and deliberately not invented: the published AIRTP structure-name list and
# Gao et al. Table 5. The HN names below come from the AIRTP-contoured TCIA2 cohort as this
# project actually read them, which overlaps that list but is not a substitute for it.
#
# One name per line. Lines beginning with # are comments.
